typical_company_profile.structure: Owner. Service coordinator. 3-15 field technicians. Optional spare-parts storekeeper. Accounts in Tally.
typical_company_profile.location: Office + field sites; technicians carry van stock for common spares.
business_models: Professional services billed by time (consulting, retainer)

item_structure.approach: Service items as non-stock OR stockable spare parts as Items with UOM Piece.
item_structure.custom_fields_required: SAC code for service lines where applicable

required_warehouses: Spares - Technician Van (virtual per tech optional Phase 2)
warehouse_setup.warehouse_logic: Van stock visibility prevents repeat site visits for missing gaskets/fuses.

questions_to_ask.question: Are technicians dispatched for breakdown calls, scheduled AMC visits, or both?
questions_to_ask.purpose: Breakdown = Issue priority; AMC = Maintenance Schedule may join Day-1 or Phase 2.

questions_to_ask.question: Do technicians carry spare parts in vans, or always return to the main store?
questions_to_ask.purpose: Van warehouse + Stock Entry consumption is Day-1 when repeat visits are a pain.

questions_to_ask.question: How do you track warranty eligibility today — serial number, invoice date, or paper card?
questions_to_ask.purpose: Warranty Claim + Serial No may be promoted when free repairs leak margin.

questions_to_ask.question: Is billing fixed-fee per visit, time-and-materials, or annual AMC contracts?
questions_to_ask.purpose: Timesheet vs Sales Order shape; Tally may keep invoicing deferred.

common_data_gaps: No central dispatch queue — WhatsApp requests lost or double-assigned.
Spare parts issued to jobs without consumption entry — margin invisible.
AMC schedules in Excel — preventive visits missed until equipment fails.

common_failures.failure: Implementing full manufacturing modules for a service company.
common_failures.why_it_fails: Work Order/BOM add noise; team never adopts ERPNext.
common_failures.correct_approach: Day-1 = Customer + Project/Issue + Timesheet + spare parts Stock Entry.

common_failures.why_it_fails: Cannot link site visits, warranty, or project costing to a client record.
common_failures.correct_approach: Customer master in ERPNext for ops trace even when Tally invoices.

bottlenecks.primary_bottleneck: No central queue for field service requests and technician assignment.
Scheduled AMC/PM visits missed — tracked offline.
Technician reaches site without required spare parts.
